name: SHIRMANI Supreme Production Scale Contract
rules: A product is public only when a concrete customer-visible artifact exists.
QC is a production release gate; independent verification remains downstream.
Never convert planned, discovered, or visual-only identities into produced-product claims.
Scale targets are targets, not completed production.
Quantum language remains quantum-inspired unless a real quantum backend is configured.
public_goal: Make production throughput, concrete artifacts, showroom readiness, and remaining work visible without requiring chat continuity.
